name: Ricochet Garden — Loop
invitation: Plates and two banks partly close a clearing, with an opening toward the tee. The shot can change, and the back bank can be turned. There is no target.
physicalQuestion: Which contact orders come back into the other surfaces, and what changes when the back bank is turned?
nearbySensitivity: At yaw -1°, elevation 16°, charge 0.55 the order is the timber back bank, then the hook plate. Yaw -1.5° and -0.5°, elevation 15.5° and 16.5°, and charge 0.54 and 0.56 keep that order. The opening aim, yaw 0° elevation 18° charge 0.55, adds the west side plate after those two. That third contact is gone at yaw -0.5°, at elevation 17.5°, and at charge 0.54.
validationEvidence: 875 headless Havok shots on one broad aim grid, seed 20261110, plus four back-bank poses, a 7-piece subset, and Open Contacts on the same grid. Neighbour walks use 0.5° and 0.01 charge steps. The seed is not applied to the solver. The validator replays six tested shots. Enjoyment, a physical phone, and speaker playback were not run.

limitations.concept: A return that meets a plate on the way back, after the outbound arc has cleared it.
limitations.missing: A plate is 4 m tall and has no height offset. A medium arc clears the plates on the way out and can meet them only after a bank has turned the ball down.
limitations.extension: One height offset on the existing plate, keeping its friction and restitution. Do not change first-ground termination.

limitations.concept: A short loop on the authored back-bank yaw, wide enough to sit on the aim sliders.
limitations.missing: The three-contact loop is a few slider steps wide. A four-contact continuation of that loop is narrower. Pieces cannot be scaled or curved.
limitations.extension: No new collider. Leave the short loop as the tested shot and keep the narrower continuation out of the starter list.

limitations.concept: Hear the timber bank with the existing H voice, plates on metal or timber, and read the contact order.
limitations.missing: This manifest opts in to the existing face-speed dynamics, the H timber-bank voice, and the note timeline. Listening on a real speaker is not checked here.
limitations.extension: No new sound engine. A later pass can keep these fields and only retune the existing H voice.

limitations.concept: The in-play panel should say which bank moves.
limitations.missing: The derived sentence names the bank kind once. The flank bank stays fixed. A saved copy does not keep the invitation.
limitations.extension: No new geometry. The invitation stays on the foundry card.

limitations.concept: Record a contact order and a moved back bank, then replay them.
limitations.missing: The validator replays the tested shots. It does not search neighbouring aims.
limitations.extension: Leave the replay as it is. The neighbour walks stay in the experiment notes.
